name: macbook-pro
title: MacBook Pro
description: A laptop drawn in SVG: a dark screen with a black notch at the top, a thin silver shell and a pale base with a shallow trackpad dip, plus a clipped display area that holds any image.
use: A desktop screenshot needs believable laptop context in a hero or feature block.
avoid: The image is cropped to fill a fixed landscape screen, so tall or square shots lose their edges.
a11y: The SVG carries no role, title or aria-label, so assistive tech gets an unlabelled graphic. (keyboard: n-a, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A wide laptop seen straight on, with a near-black screen inside a thin silver shell and a small dark notch centred at the top edge. A light grey base with softly rounded ends sits beneath it, and the screen holds a photo of horses in a field.
behaves: Static: nothing moves or responds. The image passed in is cropped to fill the screen, and the whole mockup grows or shrinks with the width and height props.
customise: The image source, width and height are props; the shell colours, notch and base are fixed in the SVG.
weight: light: One inline SVG of about a dozen shapes and a single image, with no script.
demo: Three horses, one pale and two dark, standing in a misty green field.
issues: The screen crops to fill, so images that are not landscape lose content at the sides.
polishWhy: A convincing device silhouette, but a plain stock mockup with nothing beyond the frame.
